JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'
  AND d.year = 2025
GROUP BY p.product_name
ORDER BY metric DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT d.quarter, MAX(fs.total_amount) AS metric
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY d.quarter
ORDER BY metric DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT c.region, d.quarter, p.category, SUM(fs.total_amount) AS metric
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_customer c ON fs.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN dim_product p ON fs.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY c.region, d.quarter, p.category
ORDER BY metric DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT c.customer_name, MAX(fs.total_amount) AS metric
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_customer c ON fs.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE c.region = 'West'
  AND c.segment = 'Home Office'
  AND d.year = 2024
GROUP BY c.customer_name
ORDER BY metric DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT d.quarter, COUNT(fs.sale_id) AS metric
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY d.quarter
ORDER BY metric DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT MAX(fs.total_amount) AS metric
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_customer c ON fs.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN dim_product p ON fs.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE c.region = 'South'
  AND c.segment = 'Consumer'
  AND p.category = 'Furniture'
  AND d.year = 2025

SELECT p.category, MIN(fs.total_amount) AS sales_metric, AVG(fr.refund_amount) AS returns_metric
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN fact_returns fr ON fs.sale_id = fr.return_id
JOIN dim_product p ON fs.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY sales_metric DESC
